text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: checkout route /api/checkout experiencing elevated 5xx (6.2%) in eu-west-1 during canary rollout. Canary variant=gpt-small-quant, fallback policy=sticky-region. Please acknowledge.

alex: alex (oncall) here. Looking at spike. Any immediate customer reports?

nina: support shows one high-severity merchant report (payment failures). Metrics show spike started at 1767776600. Canary traffic for checkout ~11%.

kt: config reminder: last month we adjusted sticky precedence order to reduce session splits; sticky currently outranks rollout in the precedence list in several routes. Might be related.

julia: checking routing logs: 
```
2026-06-10T19:03:12Z route_eval: route=/api/checkout user=acct-99 policy=[rollout(10%), sticky:true] decision=apply_sticky -> serve_variant=gpt-medium region=eu-west-1
2026-06-10T19:03:13Z infer: gpt-medium -> OOM error in batcher
```
Sticky routing is causing traffic to go to gpt-medium which is OOMing in eu-west.

alex: mitigation plan: 1) set route.override to force stable variant with known-good profile 2) revert precedence order to rollout-first 3) restart eu-west-1 routing workers.

kt: can flip runtime flag for precedence and apply override. Doing runtime flag flip now: `curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/flags -d 'route.checkout.precedence=rollout,region,sticky'`

opsbot: deploy-bot: Applying runtime flag change to control-plane and rolling restart in eu-west-1 (3 nodes).

opsbot: deploy-bot: Restart progress 2/3.

opsbot: deploy-bot: Restarts complete.

julia: changed override to stable: `route.override.checkout=stable/gpt-small-stable` on control-plane.

nina: metrics: 5xx dropping from 6.2% to 0.9% over 8 minutes. Merchant reports decreasing.

eng-oncall: any signs of session disruption?

kt: sampling session logs; sticky assignments adjusted for new requests only; no mass session invalidation.

product-ops: sending an interim message to affected merchants. Will coordinate final postmortem.

alex: quick RCA: precedence change allowed sticky to override canary, sending some traffic to gpt-medium in eu-west which had insufficient memory under current batcher settings. Mitigation: override to stable variant, flipped precedence, restarted routing workers.

julia: follow-ups: make precedence explicit in schema; add unit tests for precedence combinations; add rollout gating based on variant memory/regional capacity.

opsbot: Incident resolved by alex. Postmortem required within 72h.

alex: assigning owners: kt (gating/tests), julia (schema + PR), nina (customer comms). Thanks team.

product-ops: noted. Will prepare comms and timeline.
